name: f1gures-fantasy-pocketbase
description: PocketBase backend for the f1gures fantasy game (migrations, hooks, dev tooling).
//type: Pins .js files in this folder (pb_hooks/*.js) as CommonJS, which is what PocketBase's Goja runtime requires. The repo root is type=module.
//deps: Deliberately none. seed-dev.mjs uses Node 18+ global fetch so the seeder runs with no npm install. Site + scorer workstreams use the `pocketbase` SDK from the repo-root package.json instead.
